name: Re:Belial
source:
Aiji is a student who lives alone. One day, a dying incubus named Kirito appears from the drawer of Aiji’s desk. Kirito transforms from a male form into a busty woman and revives after obtaining Aiji’s semen. Kirito asks to stay at Aiji’s house and have sex with Aiji until their magical powers return. Thus begins the strange cohabitation between Aiji and a demon.

[From [url=https://yasoshima-denkiame.blogspot.com/2026/10/blog-post_12.html]Wataame no Harappa[/url]]
